SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
WEDNESDAY - APRIL 8, 2026 - 07:00 P.M.
MAIN THEATER - CERRITOS CENTER FOR THE PERFORMING ARTS
18000 PARK PLAZA DRIVE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on demand at cerritos.gov and at the Office of the City Clerk, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 1st floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the legislative body after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection in the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to city_clerk@cerritos.gov or by phone at (562) 916-1248 during regular business hours.
Order of Agenda
The City Council, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at cerritos.gov, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Main Theater at the Cerritos Center for the Performing Arts.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or in writing as described below. Public comments are limited to items listed on this special meeting agenda only.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to city_clerk@cerritos.gov or by hard copy to the Office of the City Clerk at 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703 no later than 12:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 12:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the legislative body prior to the meeting and retained with the official meeting record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact City of Cerritos ADA/504 Coordinator, Drew Schneider, at (562) 916-1314 at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD
WEDNESDAY, APRIL 8, 2026, 7:00 PM, IN THE MAIN THEATER AT THE CERRITOS
CENTER FOR THE PERFORMING ARTS, 18000 PARK PLAZA DRIVE, CERRITOS,
CALIFORNIA.

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Mike Ballentine, Chaplain, serving with the Los
  Angeles County Sheriff’s Department at the Cerritos Station Cerritos Sheriff’s
  Station.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Tigers Basketball Team.

4.  Performance of the National Anthem

  The National Anthem was performed by Leilani Joy Tom.

5.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Jennifer Hong
  Council/Agency Member Mark E. Pulido
  Council/Agency Member Sophia M. Tse
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Lynda P. Johnson
  Mayor/Chair Frank Aurelio Yokoyama

6.  Annual Mayoral Transition and City Council/Successor Agency
  Reorganization Ceremony

  A.  Welcome and introductions

  Mayor Yokoyama introduced dignitaries in attendance. Each
  Councilmember, the Mayor Pro Tem, and the Mayor introduced their
  family and guests in attendance.

  B.  Recognition of outgoing Mayor/Chair and presentations by
  dignitaries

  Presentations were made to outgoing Mayor Frank Aurelio Yokoyama. A
  video was displayed highlighting Mayor Yokoyama’s year of service.

  C.  Selection of Mayor/Chair and Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair

  Cynthia Nava, City Clerk, declared the office of Mayor/Chair vacant and
  called for nominations for the office of Mayor/Chair.

  Council/Agency Member Yokoyama nominated Council/Agency Member
  Johnson for the office of Mayor/Chair.
 City of Cerritos  Wednesday, April 8, 2026, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Special Meeting  Page 2 of 3

6.  Annual Mayoral Transition and City Council/Successor Agency
  Reorganization Ceremony (continued)

  C.  Selection of Mayor/Chair and Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair
  (continued)

  Noting there were no further nominations, the City Clerk declared
  nominations closed.

  NOMINATION: As nominated by Council/Agency Member Yokoyama,
  Council/Agency Member Johnson was presented for consideration as
  Mayor/Chair (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The nomination carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Hong, Pulido, Tse, Johnson, Yokoyama
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  The City Clerk declared Council/Agency Member Johnson as Mayor/Chair.

  Mayor/Chair Johnson declared the office of Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair
  vacant and called for nominations for the office of Mayor Pro Tem/Vice
  Chair.

  Council/Agency Member Yokoyama nominated Council/Agency Member
  Pulido for the office of Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair.

  Noting there were no further nominations, Mayor Johnson declared
  nominations closed.

  NOMINATION: As nominated by Council/Agency Member Yokoyama,
  Council/Agency Member Pulido was presented for consideration as Mayor
  Pro Tem/Vice Chair (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The nomination carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Hong, Pulido, Tse, Yokoyama, Johnson
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  The City Clerk declared Council/Agency Member Pulido as Mayor Pro
  Tem/Vice Chair.

  D.  Remarks by incoming Mayor/Chair, Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair,
  and Councilmembers

  Comments were made by Mayor/Chair Johnson and Mayor Pro Tem/Vice
  Chair Pulido.
 City of Cerritos  Wednesday, April 8, 2026, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Special Meeting  Page 3 of 3

6.  Annual Mayoral Transition and City Council/Successor Agency
  Reorganization Ceremony (continued)

  E.  Conclusion of ceremony

  Mayor/Chair Johnson invited the community to a reception at the Cerritos
  Center for the Performing Arts in the Sierra Room.

7.  Public Comments (Special Meeting Agenda Item 6 Only)

  At this juncture, the City Council, took action to continue this item, as presented
  below.

  MOTION: It was moved by Johnson, and seconded by Tse, to continue Item 7 (Public
  Comments) to a date and time certain, in accordance with California Government Code
  Section 54955, to an Adjourned Special Meeting to be held concurrently with the 7:00
  p.m. Monday, April 13, 2026 City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Hong, Tse, Yokoyama, Pulido, Johnson
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

8.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 9:03 p.m. to Monday, April 13, 2026, 7:00 p.m., in
  memory of Chief Petty Officer Samuel B. Johnson, United States Navy, Retired.

  /s/Cynthia Nava______________________
